_comment: The builder's call to the Rust envelope validator. Killed by the two tests that drive documents the TypeScript rule alone accepted — a backslash it splits on, and a NUL it never looks for. RETIRED 2026-09-17, one trial: "the miniature builder's permission is granted to every builder". It pinned `if (allowLocalFixture) args.push(...)`, and that line is gone with the permission: the only caller of `openMiniatureVfsProductBuild` was `build-abi-staging-mini-vfs.ts`, deleted with the Homebrew staging pipeline in `fc2f3ef834`, and the entry point outlived it by a year. TypeScript now never sends the flag, which is strictly stronger than sending it conditionally. The permission itself still exists in Rust and is perturbed there -- `perturb/xtask-resolved-inputs.json`, "a local-fixture reference needs no permission".
verify: cd host && npx vitest run test/vfs-product-builder-contract.test.ts >/dev/null 2>&1

trials.name: the envelope is never validated in Rust
a refused document is treated as a valid one
the refusal reported is cargo's first warning, not the rule that fired
an output built for another kernel ABI is accepted
an output bound to another ABI snapshot is accepted
